toegepas.voor: Die doel van die sang is
toegepas.rede_vinder: Avoids the clumsy 'die sang ... saam te sing' repetition; the block is already about the singing, and the maskandi block uses the same short form 'Die doel is'.
toegepas.fout: 'Die doel van die sang is om saam te sing' is circular (the purpose of the singing is to sing), and 'sang' then repeats in the next sentence.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The block's heading and topic already anchor the purpose to isicathamiya, the short form matches the maskandi block's 'Die doel is', and the meaning is unchanged.

laat_vaar.voor: maklik is om saam te dra
laat_vaar.na: maklik is om rond te dra
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Saam te dra' can be read by a learner as 'carry together'; 'rond te dra' is the natural way to say an instrument is portable.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Saamdra' (to take along with you) is correct, natural Afrikaans and suits travelling migrant workers; 'ronddra' is a lateral swap that shifts the sense slightly.

laat_vaar.voor: wat 'n kontras met die sang daarna vorm
laat_vaar.na: wat 'n kontras vorm met die sang daarna
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Moving the verb before the prepositional phrase avoids the awkward 'daarna vorm' cluster at the end of the relative clause.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original uses standard verb-final order in the relative clause and reads clearly; moving the verb is a lateral change that does not make the sentence easier to read.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Twee dinge om na te luister
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Sag teenoor hard is 'n kontras en hoog teenoor laag ook.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Sag teenoor hard is 'n kontras, en hoog teenoor laag is ook een.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The elliptical second clause reads clipped; giving it its own verb makes two full clauses, which then take the AWS comma before en.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The elliptical 'en hoog teenoor laag ook' is natural Afrikaans; 'is ook een' is heavier and only reads differently.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: in plaas van om te sing
laat_vaar_vorige.na: in plaas daarvan om te sing
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Before an om te-infinitive the standard construction is 'in plaas daarvan om te'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'in plaas van om te sing' is accepted, natural Afrikaans; the proposal is a lateral, more formal variant.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: en speel baie groepe ook 'n baskitaar en tromme
laat_vaar_vorige.na: en baie groepe speel ook 'n baskitaar en tromme
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: After the comma the second clause stands on its own, and normal subject-verb order after 'en' reads more naturally than inversion carried over from 'Vandag'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The inversion after 'en' is correct, natural Afrikaans that carries 'Vandag' into both clauses; the proposal only reorders and loosens that link.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Praat net so eerlik en met respek oor 'n ander groep se optrede.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Praat net so eerlik en met respek oor 'n ander groep se optrede as oor julle s'n.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Net so' sets up a comparison that is never completed; naming the other half makes the sentence say what it means.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Anaphoric 'net so' is normal Afrikaans and clear from the preceding sentences; the addition costs four words near the ceiling and introduces 'julle s'n' (your performance) where the paragraph spoke of your songs.
